name: evercraft-fabric
description: Attach this environment to Evercraft Fabric with explicit scopes, provenance, Context Fabric retrieval, and Systemia action boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Connect this host to the Evercraft fabric
interface.longDescription: Evercraft Fabric is a thin, permissioned gateway that lets an AI host or workspace discover Evercraft capabilities, retrieve explicitly authorized Context Fabric records, emit scoped host events as evidence, and prepare Systemia-routed action intents without treating installation as authority.
defaultPrompt: Connect this environment to Evercraft Fabric. Start with public capability discovery, show the scopes required before accessing private context, and never treat installation as execution authority.
